I couldn't find an Alberta poverty rate for people with disabilities, so I can't give you one.

The only Statistics Canada table that reports poverty by disability status is 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status" (product ID 11100090). It covers 2013 to 2024 but reports **Canada only**. It has no provincial breakdown, so Alberta isn't in it. I also searched for other tables with disability and low-income data by province and found none.

I can pull the national rate for persons with disabilities aged 15 and over, using the Market Basket Measure (the official poverty line) or the Low Income Measure. It would be a Canada-wide figure, not an Alberta one. Alberta-specific estimates may exist in custom tabulations from Statistics Canada, or in Alberta government reports, but I haven't verified either.

Source: Statistics Canada, table 11-10-0090-01 (released 2026-04-29), dimension structure checked.

I couldn't find an Alberta figure. Statistics Canada's table on poverty by disability status reports Canada only, with no provincial breakdown, and I found no other table that gives it for Alberta.

The national figure is the closest I can offer. In 2024, 12.6% of Canadians aged 15 and over with disabilities were in poverty, against 8.4% of those without disabilities. This uses the Market Basket Measure (2023 base) and covers all persons aged 15 and over. Statistics Canada rates the data quality "very good" (B).

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 11-10-0090-01 (ProductId 11100090), "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status". The vectors are v1793292452 (with disabilities) and v1793292497 (without). The reference period is 2024.

Alberta results may exist in custom tabulations from the Canadian Survey on Disability or the Canadian Income Survey. I haven't checked those.

I'm wrapping up. I found no Alberta figure, so I'm giving you the national one instead.

**I couldn't find an Alberta poverty rate for people with disabilities.** Table 11-10-0090-01, "Poverty and low-income statistics by disability status," is the Statistics Canada source for this. It only has a Canada-level geography, with no provincial breakdown. I searched the other disability tables and found no provincial poverty table, so I haven't estimated an Alberta number.

**Canada, 2024, Market Basket Measure (2023 base), persons aged 15+:**
- Persons with disabilities: **12.6%** in poverty (v1793292452)
- Persons without disabilities: **8.4%** (v1793292497)

Source: Statistics Canada, table 11-10-0090-01 (Canadian Income Survey), reference period 2024, released 2026-04-29. The data quality flag is "B = very good."

An Alberta figure would need a custom tabulation from Statistics Canada, or the Canadian Income Survey microdata through a Research Data Centre.
